description:
Reid KADe Mini | 20" Cargo eBike
A compact electric cargo bike designed to carry more and make everyday journeys easier.
The Reid KADe Mini combines a practical longtail design, 20-inch wheels and electric assistance, giving riders a versatile way to commute, shop and transport everyday essentials without relying on the car.
The Reid KADe Mini builds on the practicality of a traditional cargo bike with a more compact design that's easier to manoeuvre on everyday routes. Its 20" wheels create a shorter overall profile, while the longtail frame provides useful space for carrying additional loads. A low-step frame makes getting on and off straightforward, and the upright riding position offers comfort and good visibility when navigating busy streets.
Designed to make everyday transport more practical, the KADe Mini features a custom front basket with a maximum load capacity of 10kg, alongside a built-in rear rack for additional carrying space. From grocery shopping and commuting to carrying bags and everyday essentials, its versatile cargo setup makes it a useful alternative to a conventional commuter bike.
Electric assistance comes from an Ananda R210 36V 250W rear hub motor, helping make hills, longer journeys and loaded riding more manageable. The integrated 36V 14Ah (504Wh) battery offers an estimated range of up to 40 miles (64km), depending on terrain, rider weight, cargo load and riding conditions. An Ananda D19 display provides essential ride information, with Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility.
An 8-speed Shimano Altus M310 drivetrain, paired with an 11-34T cassette, provides a useful range of gears for different routes and gradients. Tektro HDM275 hydraulic disc brakes deliver reliable stopping power and control, while wide 20 x 3.0" tyres help provide stability, grip and comfort across a variety of urban surfaces.
Everyday practicality continues throughout the design. A steel alloy fork, comfortable riding position and wide tyres help create a stable ride, while integrated front and rear LED lights and mudguards make the KADe Mini well equipped for regular use. Its compact dimensions also make it a more manageable option for riders looking for the carrying benefits of a longtail electric cargo bike without the overall length of a larger model.
Combining practical cargo storage, dependable electric assistance and a compact design, the Reid KADe Mini 20" Cargo eBike is built to make everyday journeys more convenient. Whether it's the daily commute, a trip to the shops or carrying everything needed for the day, it offers a versatile approach to everyday cycling.
The KADe Mini 20" Cargo eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuting, with a compact longtail design and 250W electric assistance

Shopping and errands, with a custom front basket rated to carry up to 10kg

Carrying everyday essentials, with an additional built-in rear rack

Tackling hills and longer journeys, with an Ananda 250W rear hub motor

Extended everyday riding, with a 36V 14Ah (504Wh) battery offering an estimated range of up to 40 miles (64km)

Riding varied routes, with an 8-speed Shimano Altus drivetrain

Confident stopping power, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes

Comfort and stability, with wide 20 x 3.0" tyres and an upright riding position

Everyday convenience, with a low-step frame, integrated LED lights and front and rear mudguards

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike safety information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
